ex.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
ex.zh: 我們的眼睛需要時間適應黑暗。

ex.en: I could not keep the tears from my eyes.
ex.zh: 我忍不住流下眼淚。

ex.en: If only that lamp weren't shining in my eye.
ex.zh: 要是那盞燈不要照到我的眼睛就好了。

eye.en: one of the two parts of the body that you see with

eye.zh: have / keep an eye on：留意、照看

ex.en: I've had my eye on you for a while.
ex.zh: 我注意你一陣子了。

ex.en: Could you keep an eye on my bag?
ex.zh: 可以幫我看一下包包嗎？

eye.en: to watch someone or something carefully

ex.en: My eyesight is getting worse.
ex.zh: 我的視力正慢慢下降。

ex.en: Have you had your eyesight checked recently?
ex.zh: 你最近檢查視力了嗎？

ex.en: He lost his eyesight in the accident.
ex.zh: 他在意外中失明了。

ex.en: She raised one eyebrow and looked at me.
ex.zh: 她挑起一邊眉毛看著我。

ex.en: Sweat ran down from his eyebrow.
ex.zh: 汗水從他的眉毛流下來。

ex.en: I need to trim my eyebrows.
ex.zh: 我需要修一下眉毛。

ex.en: An eyewitness told the police what she saw.
ex.zh: 一位目擊者向警方說出她所看到的。

ex.en: The eyewitness account helped solve the case.
ex.zh: 目擊者的證詞幫助破了案。

ex.en: Police are looking for eyewitnesses to the accident.
ex.zh: 警方正在尋找這起事故的目擊者。

ex.en: My eyelid keeps twitching when I am tired.
ex.zh: 我累的時候眼皮會一直跳。

ex.en: She closed her heavy eyelids and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 她闔上沉重的眼皮睡著了。

ex.en: A small bug landed on his eyelid.
ex.zh: 一隻小蟲停在他的眼皮上。

ex.en: Dust got into his eyeball and made it hurt.
ex.zh: 灰塵跑進他的眼球，讓眼睛很痛。

ex.en: The doctor explained how the eyeball moves in its socket.
ex.zh: 醫師解釋眼球如何在眼窩裡轉動。

ex.en: Look into the eyepiece to see the stars.
ex.zh: 從目鏡看進去就能看到星星。

ex.en: The microscope has a cracked eyepiece.
ex.zh: 這台顯微鏡的目鏡裂了。

ex.en: A tiny eyelash fell onto her cheek.
ex.zh: 一根小小的睫毛掉到她的臉頰上。

ex.en: She curled her eyelashes before going out.
ex.zh: 她出門前先把睫毛夾翹。

ex.en: She cleaned her eyeglasses with a soft cloth.
ex.zh: 她用軟布擦拭眼鏡。

ex.en: He lost his eyeglasses on the train.
ex.zh: 他把眼鏡掉在火車上了。
